items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 4 at 4:45AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
Patchy fog is settling over the area this morning. The fog may
become locally dense, reducing visibilities on area roadways.
Improving conditions are expected after 8AM.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down and leave extra distance ahead of you in
case a sudden stop is needed.
